caption:
A small multi-rotor craft is suspended near the center of a very dark scene. Its dark oval body has pale golden arms extending outward to spinning rotors. The rotor blades appear as soft blurred discs that fluctuate slightly in shape and orientation. The craft stays intact and about the same size while drifting slightly rightward across the dark scene. The surrounding background remains mostly black, with faint uneven tones near the lower edge and sides, suggesting dim distant structures, low forms, and terrain barely visible in the deep darkness.

The spinning rotors continue to blur throughout, clearly showing ongoing rotor motion without stopping. The craft holds its form and steady illumination, neither taking off nor settling, with no collision or structural change apparent. The dim background gradually reveals faint horizontal bands and low shapes along the bottom and lower edge areas. The craft remains the main illuminated subject while the surrounding scene stays very low contrast and almost entirely dark.
